legacy.evidence: Previously conjecture while an extra substrate mode's coupling was unspecified; refuted for this wake's field once the sourced wall and Branch C fixed that scope. GW170817 pins the observed tensor speed near \(c\) ([scalar-gravity-ppn-constraints](../../studies/scalar-gravity-ppn-constraints.md)) and Moore & Nelson give Cherenkov bounds of \(c-c_g<2\times10^{-15}c\) (Galactic) and ~\(2\times10^{-19}c\) (extragalactic) for any conventionally coupled mode ([moving-source-gravity-bounds](../../studies/moving-source-gravity-bounds.md) § gravitational Cherenkov). The escape through an extra, differently coupled substrate mode closed with Branch C: its potential is the conventionally coupled one ([Branch C](../moving-source-field-consistency/branch-c.md) § Walls). Galaxies at \(10^{-3}c\) never outrun the field
